title: Tuskegee student group and rivalry with Erskine Hawkins
summary: He and fellow students, including a Stevenson, try to form a group to outdo Erskine Hawkins' band at Alabama State.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And so then I was on my way and (inaudible) we were started to get together with each other and play around and do you remember
Well, he was in the band. Stevens was his last name, I can't think of his first name.
He got killed in the service, didn't he?
He may have. I don't remember.
But he was the high man with Lunsford.

Well, his home is Tuskegee and he meant a lot to me, a little competition between us and Hawkins, was at Alabama State at Montgomery and they began to talk about him, so we were trying to have a little group to outdo Erskine Hawkins down at Alabama State.
